container: lenient_decode_v1.bin: one segment per vector, each a 4-byte big-endian u32 length followed by a complete hand-built NON-canonical MSSP frame (16-byte header + MessagePack body); segment order matches the vectors array below

conventions.integers: u64/i64/u128 values are decimal strings; u8/u32 values are plain JSON numbers
conventions.byte_strings: byte strings are lowercase hex in *_hex fields (empty string = empty bytes)
conventions.oids: a UniOid is {"h": ..., "l": ...} with both u64 halves as decimal strings
conventions.unit: a unit (ok, no payload) result is {"unit": true}
conventions.relation_cells: a relation row is an array of cells; each cell is a hex string or null; a null row means no row found
conventions.direction: request = decode with the request codec, response = decode with the result codec

vectors.note: u64 value 2 encoded with the u32 marker 0xCE instead of fixint 0x02
i64 offset 8 encoded with the unsigned u8 marker 0xCC instead of fixint 0x08
i64 offset -2 encoded with the i64 marker 0xD3 instead of negfixint 0xFE
fs-open argv record map keys in 4,3,2,1 order instead of 1,2,3,4
fs-open argv record map with an unknown field number 99 (skipped)
fs-open argv map with a string key "note" (skipped)
fs-read request without parameter 2 (len defaults to 0)
query result whose record field omits the variant field_type (default case scalar(bool)) and field_attrs, and whose result_set is absent
